about.title: About Me
about.para1: My journey started with AI research and competitive programming training (OLP/ICPC), where I built a strong habit of reasoning under tight constraints. As I moved into Software Engineering, I positioned myself as a Product Engineer — responsible for the entire product lifecycle from architectural design to end-user experience.
about.para2: I am strongest when working on systems that need clear boundaries, resilient asynchronous processing, and smart trade-off decisions. I believe great software isn't just about running correctly; it must be observable, scalable, and highly optimized for operational resources.
about.skills_intro: Here are a few technologies and practices I have been working with recently:

points: Frontend & Senior-First UX: Built the interface using Next.js 15 (App Router, Turbopack), Tailwind CSS v4, and Radix UI; standardized UX for elderly users (70+): prevented CTA line-wrapping (whitespace-nowrap), developed ImagePasteDropzone component (supporting direct Ctrl+V invoice screenshot pasting from Zalo/Clipboard), and implemented adaptive dynamic viewport modals (max-h-[90dvh]).

Backend & Data Layer: Architected Next.js Server Actions, Prisma ORM, and Supabase PostgreSQL; developed a recursive serializePrisma utility to eliminate runtime serialization crashes when passing Prisma Decimal instances to Client Components.

Accounting State Machine (ADR-005): Designed a debt lifecycle state machine introducing the ROLLED_INTO status executed within atomic prisma.$transaction operations, eliminating 100% of double-counting debt bugs when carrying unpaid balances into new billing periods.

Enterprise Soft Delete & Testing: Implemented soft delete with unique constraint suffixing (roomNumber_del_timestamp) to release unique key constraints while guaranteeing 100% accounting audit trail preservation; created automated Playwright E2E test suites covering utility meter logging and invoice generation flows.

MVP Core (April 2026): Architected and launched a digital table-ordering MVP within 1 month using React 18 SPA, Firebase Firestore, dynamic 24/7 EMVCo Napas VietQR generation (0% intermediary fees, no POS hardware needed), Web Audio API chimes, and instant Telegram Bot order webhooks.

Cost Optimization & Client Cache: Implemented a client-side caching architecture via IndexedDB, reducing Firestore read operations by 90% for returning guests and maintaining a $0/month operational footprint throughout testing.

Hybrid Monorepo Upgrade (From September 2026): Restructured the codebase into a Hybrid Monorepo fusing Astro 5 SSG (Zero-JS static marketing/blog, TTFB < 50ms, 100/100 Core Web Vitals) and React 18 SPA through a custom merge-dist.mjs script deployed to Vercel CDN Edge.

Agentic SEO & GEO Engine: Implemented Generative Engine Optimization for AI Search (ChatGPT Search, Perplexity, Claude): standardized llms.txt, structured Answer-First content within 150 words, and integrated Triple Schema JSON-LD (SoftwareApplication, Restaurant, FAQ).

Backend & Asynchronous Architecture: Developed microservices with FastAPI and NestJS, orchestrating distributed message queues (Celery, Azure Service Bus) with worker pools and exponential backoff retry policies for automated fault recovery.

Message Queue & Payload Optimization: Overcame cloud message broker payload size constraints by transmitting temporary SAS URLs and reference IDs instead of streaming raw files, minimizing network latency and system bandwidth overhead.

Audio Signal Processing (Confidential): Built a multi-format audio validation pipeline (MP3, WAV, Librosa DSP) with real-time result streaming, resolving cross-browser compatibility (Safari Web Audio) and keep-alive handling under heavy load.

Fullstack & CI/CD Delivery: Developed management dashboards and client-facing interfaces with React and Tailwind CSS; configured CI/CD automation via GitHub Actions for linting, testing, and zero-downtime deployment.
